summary: Iteration 2 validated: SMTP now owns signature_html and reply_to, /api/signatures removed, settings has no default_signature, and Smartize branding (logo) appears on Login, Sidebar, Footer and 404. Backend 38/38 pytest green, all iteration-2 UI flows green.

integration_issues.flow: SignatureEditor visual mode after code edit
integration_issues.issue: After editing HTML in the 'Código HTML' tab and switching back to 'Visual', the contentEditable div did not immediately re-render the updated HTML (inner_html did not contain the edited text). The value/preview is however correct and persists correctly on save (verified via GET /api/smtp and reload-on-edit). Root cause: useEffect only depends on [mode] and editorRef.current may still be null on the first render of the tab; consider adding a small setTimeout or including 'value' in the effect and checking ref availability.

action_items: (Low) Fix SignatureEditor: when switching from 'Código HTML' tab to 'Visual', re-hydrate the contentEditable div with the current value once the ref is attached (e.g., add ref callback or include [mode, value] in the effect with ref-null check).
critical_code_review_comments: api.py serialize() correctly excludes password_enc, verified via test_list_no_password + explicit API probe.
worker._send_job concatenates smtp.signature_html to html_body — verify template rendering for HTML emails (not tested end-to-end with an SMTP receiver; pytest covers API structure only).
SmtpUpdate accepts password='' and preserves prior password (verified). Good.
SettingsUpdate no longer accepts default_signature; extra fields are silently dropped by Pydantic (verified — 200 response, field not persisted).
SignatureEditor uses document.execCommand (deprecated but still works in Chrome/Firefox). Consider migrating to a maintained rich-text lib in future.
Nav testids still use accents (nav-configurações) — flagged in iteration_1, unchanged.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_smtp and TEST_ smtp accounts via Playwright + pytest; all cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend routes are PT: /configuracoes (NOT /settings), /campanhas, /contactos, /grupos, /estatisticas. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope so run serial with `pytest -n 0`. GET /api/smtp exposes signature_html and reply_to but NOT password/password_enc. /api/smtp/test-send accepts {smtp_account_id,to_email,signature_html?} and always 200s with {success,message}. /api/signatures returns 404 (endpoint removed).
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found in iteration 2 scope.
